title: Successful logins must not consume password-failure budget
body: The original guard counted all login POSTs toward five attempts per fifteen minutes. Browser verification and smoke tests used the shared proxy identity and exhausted the allowance with successful logins, making the owner's unchanged password return 429. Do not trust arbitrary forwarded-IP headers to work around this.
resolution: Count only incorrect passwords under a Postgres row lock, reset failures on successful login, preserve the five-failure lockout with Retry-After, and retain a separate sixty-request-per-minute cap. Clear the pre-fix login failure bucket during this rollout. Regression tests cover repeated success, resetting failures, concurrent attempts and expiry.
